description: The C49 face-match calibration set: Wikimedia Commons official portraits under PD-USGov-NASA, PD-USGov-DOS or PD-USGov-Military* (no Congress portraits, no file tagged Personality rights), harvested on 2026-10-22 by scripts/fetch_fixtures.py --harvest-calibration from the categories Official portrait photographs of NASA; Official portrait photographs of the United States Department of State; Official portrait photographs of the United States Armed Forces and their subcategories (3 levels). A file is kept only when exactly one person is named, by its structured-data depicts or a per-person category, every source agrees, and neither its title nor a category announces several people; JPEG originals of at most 40 MB, one copy of each, at most 5 per person spread over the years; only people with two photos or more. Identities are pseudonymous; years come from the file's date or inception, sex from the person's Wikidata entry.
purpose: Measuring the false-match and false-non-match rates of OpenVerify's shared SFace face-match threshold (docs/calibration/selfie-phase4.md). The images are fetched on demand into fixtures/faces/calibration/ and never committed; embeddings are computed in memory and never stored; the report keeps aggregate numbers only.
takedown: To remove a person: delete their identity here (find it by the file URL), delete their files from fixtures/faces/calibration/, re-run services/vision/tools/calibrate_selfie.py and the report, and commit both. Removal requests: open an issue in the project's repository.
